text:
maria: Heads-up, spotted ~25% drop in prefix cache hit-rate after last runtime deploy (adaptive-kernel-picker + mixed-quant pass).
kevin: ugh. which deploy ID? can you paste perf numbers?
maria: deploy id `runtime-2026-03-16-kerpick-v2` — looking at token-level metrics: prefix_hit_rate went from 0.87 -> 0.66 for our T5-like workloads across 4 hosts.
ashwin: can we confirm it's not a change in request distribution? maybe more unique prompts?
maria: checked top-100 traffic; distribution stable. added a quick script to diff tokenizer hashes and build ids, nothing obvious.
eli: throwing profiler traces now. if it's kernel selection we should see different kernel variants chosen during early steps / priming.
infra-bot: rolling trace capture on hosts gpu-3,gpu-7 (trace_id=trace-3170012345-01).
kevin: paste a small snippet of the kernel decisions from one trace pls.
maria: snippet from trace (first 120 tokens):
```
kernel_picker: selected=matmul_fused_v3 if seq_len>32 and quant=8bit
kernel_picker: fallback=matmul_generic if kv_cache_prefill==true
quant_profile: layer_group=2 -> int8_mixed
attn_impl: tiled_flash_attn_v2 for heads>16
```
ashwin: hmm fallback condition `kv_cache_prefill==true` looks suspect. we set a flag to prefer generic matmul during warmup to avoid mis-keying, but maybe the new picker flips selection when mixed-quant enabled.
eli: compare the prefix key canonicalization logs. if kernels change layout (padding/order) it can change fingerprint.
maria: found differences: when fused matmul used, prefix fingerprint = sha1(prefix_bytes) but with generic matmul we were using `sha1(prefix_bytes + padding_order_flag)` — two different canonicalizations.
sre-jen: that mismatch is scary. means same logical prompt can map to two cache keys depending on kernel variant.
kevin: agree — this could explain hit-rate drop only on nodes that got the new kernel rollout. which nodes are impacted?
infra-bot: rollout history: nodes [gpu-3,gpu-4,gpu-7] got `kerpick-v2` at 02:13 UTC, rest still on `kerpick-v1`.
maria: cross-checking hit-rate by host: these three hosts show 40-50% worse warmup hit-rate on median.
ashwin: quick mitigation: revert kernel picker change for prefilling path or unify key canonicalization. which is lower risk?
eli: unify canonicalization is safer long-term but needs a small runtime change; revert picker gives immediate improvement.
kevin: opt for rollback on prod-traffic path and push canonicalization fix to branch. schedule canary after fix.
maria: creating rollback PR + hotfix for canonicalization. PR: `hotfix/prefix-key-canonicalize` (link)
kevin: also add unit tests that sign rounds for fingerprint under both kernel paths.
ashwin: can we add an invariant check in CI that for any model/profile we compute both keys and assert equality?
eli: yes — `kv_cache_key(prefix, kernel_variant)` should be deterministic independent of variant. we'll add a shim to normalize ordering and pad bytes identically.
sre-jen: after rollback let's monitor cold-start latency too (if we revert to generic kernels latency might increase). put alert threshold at 1.2x baseline.
maria: rollback started for runtime-kerpick-v2 on the three nodes. infra-bot will post when done.
infra-bot: rollback complete on gpu-3,gpu-4,gpu-7 at 02:49 UTC (trace=trace-3170012345-rollback).
maria: post-rollback hit-rate back to ~0.86 on those hosts after 20 minutes.
kevin: great. follow-up: 1) canonicalization hotfix 2) add test harness 3) extend profiler to tag kernel selection in prefix fingerprinting logs 4) schedule careful canary of kerpick-v2 with the fix.
ashwin: also check mixed-quant path where int8 reorderings may alter in-memory layout. add a test with quantized kernels.
eli: I've started the hotfix branch. quick patch (pseudocode):
```
def canonicalize_prefix(p):
    tokens = normalize_unicode(p)
    order = fixed_padding_order
    return sha1(serialize(tokens, order))
```
kevin: keep it tiny. ship to stage, run synthetic replay (10k requests) to validate hit-rate and latency delta.
sre-jen: I'll add an SLO monitor and temporary page-on-call for the canary.
maria: thanks all — logging actions in epic: PERF-4592. will follow up with a brief postmortem once hotfix merges. :thumbsup:
kevin: nice triage. low-churn fix + test should prevent recurrence.
eli: added an integration test that runs both kernel variants and asserts equal keys. pushed to `hotfix/prefix-key-canonicalize`.
maria: will coordinate canary next week after CI green. closing thread for now.
